prompt: A search box sends an API request on every keystroke, flooding the server.
why: Debounce: send only after typing pauses for ~250 ms.
trap: Caching doesn't stop the flood of new queries.

prompt: An infinite-scroll handler runs 100 times a second while scrolling and makes the page stutter.
trap: The handler, not the DOM size, is the cost here.

prompt: A document editor saves on every change, creating hundreds of versions per minute.
why: Debounce autosave to a pause in typing.
trap: Saving optimistically still saves too often.

prompt: Recomputing a chart layout on every window resize event makes resizing feel sticky.
why: Throttle or debounce the resize handler.
trap: A worker can't touch the DOM layout.

prompt: A sticky-header effect recalculates on every scroll event and drops frames.
trap: Not a long list, just a hot handler.

prompt: Checking whether a username is available calls the server after each character typed.
why: Debounce the check until typing pauses.
trap: Caching won't help new partial names.

prompt: Mouse-move tracking sends hundreds of analytics events per second.
tells: hundreds of analytics events per second
trap: A worker moves the work; it doesn't reduce it.

prompt: A "Save" button should react on the first click immediately, then ignore extra clicks for a second.
tells: react on the first click immediately
ignore extra clicks for a second
why: Leading-edge throttle: act first, then suppress.
trap: Trailing debounce would delay the first click.
